verdict.rationale: ADK documents first-party developer Skills and an Agents CLI built so a user's AI coding assistant can scaffold, build, test, evaluate, and deploy ADK agents. That gives natural-language operation, but only through an external assistant rather than a native natural-language command interface. Agent Config is no-code configuration, not natural-language operation, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: native natural-language command interface in ADK itself, detailed docs on what the Skills cover, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: ADK is designed to be written by both humans and AI. Connect your favorite coding assistant to our ADK developer Skills and AI-aware developer resources
Use your favorite AI-enabled developer environment to scaffold, build, test, evaluate, and deploy with Agents CLI.
